literal: To those who live, sky like yielding indeed; to those who love, loved ones giving affection.
translation: The affection shown by the beloved to those who deeply love them is as reviving as the rain yielded by the sky to sustain life.
modern: உலகத்தில் வாழும் உயிர்களுக்கு மழை பெய்து காப்பது போன்றது, அன்பு செலுத்துவோருக்கு அவர் விரும்பும் காதலர் காட்டும் அன்பு.
explanation: This couplet compares the life-giving nature of rain to the reviving power of a lover's affection. Just as the sky yields rain to sustain all living beings, the beloved's grace sustains the life of the one who deeply loves them. The word 'வானம்' (sky) stands for the rain it brings, emphasizing that without the beloved's affection, the lover cannot survive.
